SELECT i.material_id AS "productId", MAX(i.material_name) AS "productName", MAX(i.unit) AS unit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(i.total_cost), 0) / SUM(i.quantity) ELSE 0 END AS "costPrice", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.location_type IN ('CENTRAL', 'DEPOT') THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "warehouseStock", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.location_type = 'STORE' THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "storeStock", COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS "totalStock", COALESCE(SUM(i.total_cost), 0) AS "totalValue", COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.location_type = 'STORE' THEN i.location_id END), 0) AS "storeCount" FROM inventory i JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = i.location_id AND l.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0
AND i.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
GROUP BY i.material_id ORDER BY "totalStock" DESC
